contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantine I (306-337), Vow in wreath issue of 320-325, Reece period 16. Obverse description: Head laureate right. Obverse inscription: [--]TANTINV[--]. Reverse description: Vow in wreath [illegible]. Reverse inscription: [DN CONSTANT]INVS MAX AVG. Diameter: 18.8mm, Weight: 1.93gms, die axis: probably 12
